_about: Monta FG2 fixed-grip double terminals (v0.3.2, owner LD1, LD5): the Monta FG4's at a 11 ft line gauge through its own gauge rule (monta_drive.gauge_shift, gauge_wheel): the terminals keep the FG4's size; the bullwheel's rim and the sheaves with their mounts follow the gauge (owner photo). They carry the Sessellift narrow chairs (Q4). Rope sockets and sheaves keep the 1 3/4 in rope (LD7). Millimetres.
